decision.overall_recommendation: Gate is open, so new entries are permissible. The pool skews toward biotech/industrials/utilities deep pullbacks with generally modest fundamentals; the cleanest names (CSCO, CGNX, ASTH, KMT, PVH, KIM) combine confirmed support with genuine beat streaks and, in a few cases, real insider buying, while roughly a third of the pool shows forming (not yet confirmed) support and should be treated with extra caution. Several names carry tape-confirmed negative catalysts or heavy/rising short interest that argue for selectivity. The system's own recent track record is weak (8% win rate, -1.25% average return over 25 picks) - that argues for lower overall conviction across the board, not for changing how any individual trade is sized.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in all 8 of the last 8 quarters (e.g., $1.22 vs $1.17 est in August) with revenue growth accelerating; the Aug 12 'double beat' print still saw the stock drop -8.41% on 2.94x volume on margin worries (now -13.17% since, but 48 days stale), and a Piper Sandler target cut on Sept 22 (-4.51% on 3.19x vol) is also fading into the base.
ranked_picks.rationale: Best-in-pool fundamentals (8/8 beats, steady double-digit growth) with clean trend_continuation support and no fresh catalyst overhang earns the top spot.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Two stale-but-real negative tape reactions (post-earnings margin selloff, analyst target cut) show the market capping upside on valuation/margin worries even as fundamentals stay strong; no insider buying to offset routine officer selling.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in all 8 of the last 8 quarters with net income growth accelerating to +41% last quarter; announced a $500M RealSense acquisition on Sept 22 that the tape rejected - closed -4.86% on 2.53x volume and remains -2.14% below the pre-news close.
ranked_picks.rationale: Matches CSCO on beat/growth quality, but the tape-confirmed negative reaction to the M&A deal is a real read-through on capital allocation, placing it just behind CSCO in the confirmed/trend_continuation tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The RealSense deal was tape-confirmed as a negative surprise (sold on 2.5x volume, still underwater) on top of a Hold analyst consensus and CEO insider selling in August.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Turned a run of large misses into two consecutive beats (Aug: $0.40 vs $0.3358; May: $0.30 vs $0.29), with net income growth accelerating sharply (+150% and +1508% off a low base in the prior two quarters). No news catalyst either way.
ranked_picks.rationale: A genuine recent turnaround in earnings execution and accelerating growth, with no catalyst noise or red flags, earns a solid spot in the confirmed/trend_continuation tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The turnaround is only two quarters old after a long run of large misses, and days-to-cover of 11.7 means any disappointment could see an outsized reaction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 6 of the last 8 quarters (most recently $1.83 vs $1.62); no fresh catalyst, with analyst targets drifting mildly lower (-3.8% recent revision).
ranked_picks.rationale: Solid, unspectacular beat record and clean support place it mid-pack in the confirmed/trend_continuation tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: A single-director insider sale and a mild negative target revision add modest caution; the book already carries industrials exposure (SectorOverlap).

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 5 of the last 8 quarters with net income growth swinging sharply positive the last two quarters; no recent news, last item is a stale 55-day-old downgrade.
ranked_picks.rationale: Decent, improving fundamentals and a clean setup; ranked just behind TKR/ASTH because the beat record includes two misses in the trailing eight quarters.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Energy-services earnings are volatile quarter to quarter and levered to drilling activity; no insider buying to anchor conviction.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in roughly 6 of the last 8 quarters including a large August beat, with a positive recent target revision (+3.6%); no material recent catalyst (the notable target bump is now 72 days stale).
ranked_picks.rationale: Decent beat record, but a weak underlying quant score (D+, pre-revenue clinical biotech) places it behind names with steadier cash generation.
ranked_picks.bear_case: An officer sold ~$2M in July; as an early-stage biotech, a negative trial readout could hit hard, and short-interest data is unavailable to gauge crowding.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 6 of the last 8 quarters (typical lumpy comps for a small hotel REIT); a Sept 28 analyst downgrade (2 days old) was tape-confirmed with a -1.12% close on 2.1x volume, still -1.3% below that print.
ranked_picks.rationale: Decent beat history is offset by a genuinely recent, tape-confirmed negative catalyst and a weak Hold consensus (4 sell ratings), pulling it down within the confirmed/trend_continuation tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: A Hold consensus with 4 outright sells signals limited analyst conviction, and the fresh downgrade adds a real overhang with no offsetting target-revision data.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Revenue growth turned negative last quarter (-10.8%) and EPS missed ($-0.07 vs $-0.02 est) after a string of prior beats; heavy insider selling over 90 days ($17M net, including a $10.3M fund exit by Voss Capital and a $4.4M CEO sale) despite a positive analyst target revision (+14.8%).
ranked_picks.rationale: A recent miss, decelerating revenue, and heavy insider/fund selling are a real fundamental red flag that keeps it near the bottom of the confirmed/trend_continuation tier despite clean technicals.
ranked_picks.bear_case: CEO and officers selling into a stock that has been declining is the meaningful kind of insider selling per this framework, and the Voss Capital fund exit is a separate supply overhang.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Revenue is just ramping off a commercial launch, but the FDA approval news (Sept 14) that should have been the catalyst was sold hard - closed -6.41% on 2.36x volume and sits -12.75% below the pre-news close three weeks later, with continued selling on follow-on coverage.
ranked_picks.rationale: Even a genuine business catalyst (first commercial approval) was decisively rejected by the tape, and short interest is both large and growing, so it ranks at the bottom of the confirmed/trend_continuation tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: HeavilyShorted and ShortsAdding reads as a headwind here, not squeeze fuel - shorts added into the approval and have been proven right so far; directors sold ~$920K before the news, and the underlying quant score is weak.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: A-rated fundamentals with net income growth accelerating (+290% then +72% in the last two quarters) and a beat in 6 of the last 8 quarters (most recently $2.96 vs $2.31); two open-market insider purchases (~$355K) partially offset officer selling.
ranked_picks.rationale: Best fundamentals in the reversion_bounce group (top analyst score, accelerating growth, real insider buying) earns the top reversion_bounce slot, even though that setup carries a weaker backtested edge than trend_continuation.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Reversion_bounce setups exit on a fixed target rather than a trailing stop, limiting upside if the fundamental story keeps improving; the stock remains below both its 50- and 200-day trend EMAs.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in all 8 of the last 8 quarters (most recently $3.70 vs $3.08); a director/officer bought $1M of stock in the open market on Sept 11 - real insider buying into a discounted apparel name.
ranked_picks.rationale: An unbroken beat streak plus genuine insider buying is a strong combination, ranked just behind KMT only because the overall quality score (C+) and medium-term target cuts are a touch weaker.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Apparel retail is cyclical and consumer-spending sensitive; the reversion_bounce setup caps the trade at a fixed target rather than letting a trend run.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in all 8 of the last 8 quarters (most recently $0.22 vs $0.1962) with a completely clean flag profile; RSI14 at 27.2 signals a genuinely oversold retail REIT.
ranked_picks.rationale: An immaculate beat record and zero red flags make this one of the cleanest reversion_bounce candidates, just behind KMT/PVH because of a Hold consensus and a -13.2% recent target revision.
ranked_picks.bear_case: No catalyst to spark a bounce and the stock remains in a clear downtrend (both trend EMAs declining); grocery-anchored REITs are rate-sensitive.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Consistent performer - beat or met estimates in 7 of the last 8 quarters (most recently $1.79 vs $1.78), completely clean flag profile, no news catalyst either way.
ranked_picks.rationale: Utility-grade consistency and a clean setup earn a solid mid-pack slot among reversion_bounce names; low beta (0.47) is a lower-volatility complement to the more speculative names ranked above.
ranked_picks.bear_case: No catalyst and a low-beta utility profile mean any bounce is likely slow and modest; the stock remains below both trend EMAs.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in the last 3 straight quarters after a mixed run (most recently $0.33 vs $0.1828), though short interest rose 16.1% in the latest FINRA report.
ranked_picks.rationale: A recent beat streak is a positive signal, but the mixed longer-term record and rising short interest keep it in the middle of the reversion_bounce pack.
ranked_picks.bear_case: ShortsAdding at +16.1% could reflect genuine bearish conviction rather than squeeze fuel in a REIT still in a technical downtrend, with no insider buying to counter it.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 6 of the last 8 quarters including a record Q2 print, but that very beat (July 27) triggered a -24.91% single-session crash on 2.79x volume on weak guidance - still -13.78% below that level two months later; medium-term analyst target revisions are strongly positive (+37%).
ranked_picks.rationale: A strong headline beat record is undercut by a serious (if now stale) guidance-driven crash on execution/visibility, placing it behind the cleaner names in this tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: A beat-and-crash on guidance warns that consensus numbers may be ahead of reality; the stock has since swung double digits on multiple sessions, adding execution risk to a reversion trade.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Two straight EPS beats after a run of misses, with net income growth turning sharply positive as the 'Back to Starbucks' turnaround gains traction; a Sept 25 store-closure headline read negatively, but the stock actually closed +1.31% on 1.7x volume and remains +0.34% since - a negative headline the market shrugged off.
ranked_picks.rationale: An improving earnings trend plus resilience to negative news is a mild positive, but the longer record still shows more misses than beats and short interest is elevated, keeping it mid-pack.
ranked_picks.bear_case: HeavilyShorted, and the turnaround thesis still has more to prove given four misses in the six quarters before the recent upturn; officer selling in September adds a little more caution.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 5 of the last 8 quarters including one large beat; RSI14 at 28.6 is genuinely oversold, and a Sept 28 'oversold utilities' mention is routine coverage rather than a real catalyst.
ranked_picks.rationale: A decent beat record and oversold RSI give it a reasonable case, but the support check flags a severe trend failure, consistent with the forming classification.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The severe trend-check failure means the slide hasn't clearly stopped; an officer sold stock on Sept 28 right as the stock continued lower.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Mixed beat/miss record (4 beats, 4 misses over 8 quarters); a Sept 25 analyst downgrade was shrugged off by the tape (stock closed +1.04% on 1.6x volume that session) - a negative headline the market didn't sell.
ranked_picks.rationale: An even-money beat record and a shrugged-off downgrade are mildly encouraging, but the support check shows a severe trend failure, placing it in the forming tier behind cleaner fundamental stories.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Heavy insider selling over 90 days ($9.8M, both officers) into a stock that hasn't confirmed its low is a caution; Burger King-driven margin pressure remains a live risk.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Diversified holding company (insurance, energy pipelines, hotels) with generally rising per-share profit despite volatile quarterly net income growth; no EPS estimates available to score a beat/miss record, and a clean flag profile.
ranked_picks.rationale: Low-beta and no red flags, but 2 of 3 support checks failed (volume, trend), keeping it in the forming tier; limited analyst coverage (only 4 ratings) reduces conviction either way.
ranked_picks.bear_case: Sparse analyst coverage and no EPS-estimate history make earnings quality hard to judge objectively; the pullback isn't yet confirmed as stabilizing.

ranked_picks.research_highlight: Mixed EPS record (4 beats, 3 misses, 1 in-line) typical of a regulated utility with lumpy quarters; minor insider selling by two officers in August; no news in the window.
ranked_picks.rationale: A middling beat record and a 'severe' range-check failure in the support data place it below the stronger utility/REIT names in the forming tier.
ranked_picks.bear_case: The range component of the support check registered severe, meaning the recent price action hasn't meaningfully settled; a mostly-Hold analyst consensus offers little conviction.

excluded.reason: Deteriorating/weak clinical-stage fundamentals (consistent losses, minimal realized revenue, C- rating, actual downtrend with price below both trend EMAs) combined with a tape-confirmed negative catalyst - the Sept 8 AATD data readout closed -9.67% on 4.26x average volume and the stock remains -17.75% below that pre-news close three weeks later, i.e., the market rejected the news outright.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 6 of the last 8 quarters with net income growth of +37% last quarter; an Aug 11 earnings beat sparked a +17.2% single-session pop on 3.85x volume, but the stock has since round-tripped and sits -9.82% below that level (now 50 days stale).
sector_capped_out.rationale: Solid beat history, but a sharp post-earnings round trip (the entire pop faded) is a caution sign that places it behind the cleaner names in this tier.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: HeavilyShorted at 10.65% of float; the stock has given back its entire earnings pop over the past seven weeks, suggesting the good news is already priced out.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Mixed beat/miss record on lumpy construction comps; one open-market insider purchase ($49.6K) in the last 90 days with zero insider selling - a small but genuine positive signal.
sector_capped_out.rationale: The clean insider-buying signal differentiates it from peers with heavier officer selling, but a mixed earnings record and downtrending technicals keep it in the lower half of the tier.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: The long-term trend EMA200 slope is negative and the stock remains well below both trend EMAs; construction end-markets are cyclical and rate-sensitive.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Pre-revenue clinical-stage biotech; EPS has tracked close to estimates most quarters but there's no revenue story; no material recent news.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Clean support and setup, but a weak fundamental profile (C- rating, no revenue) and heavy short interest place it in the lower half of the reversion_bounce tier.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: HeavilyShorted at 12.2% of float with a director selling $1.7M in August; as a clinical-stage name with no revenue, any pipeline setback could be severe.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Pre-commercial clinical biotech (D+ overall rating) with heavy short interest (25.75% of float); no news catalyst in either direction.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Weakest fundamental quality score among the confirmed reversion_bounce names, which is why it sits near the bottom despite a technically clean setup.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Extremely high short interest (25.75% of float, 14.7 days to cover) reads as a real headwind given the weak fundamental score, not obvious squeeze fuel; CEO sold stock in July.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Volatile airline EPS record with big beats and misses; analyst price targets cut sharply (-13.6% recent revision on 2 analysts) while short interest rose 16.9% in the latest report.
sector_capped_out.rationale: The combination of TargetsBeingCut and ShortsAdding is a real fundamental red flag that places this at the bottom of the confirmed tier despite a reasonable beat record.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: Rising short interest alongside falling analyst targets suggests growing bearish conviction, not a squeeze setup, on a name still in a technical downtrend.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: A-rated fundamentals with an improving beat streak (4 straight beats/in-lines) and accelerating net income growth (+24% last quarter); no news catalyst in the last 7 weeks.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Despite the strongest fundamental score in the whole pool, all three SupportCheck components (range, volume, trend) failed, downgrading the read from 'stabilising' to forming - support_status dominates the ranking, so it sits below every confirmed name regardless of setup quality.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: The pullback hasn't genuinely stabilized by the data (range still expanding, volume still selling-heavy, trend still sliding), so there's real risk of buying before the knife has stopped falling.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Beat EPS in 7 of the last 8 quarters (most recently $2.58 vs $1.87) with a clean flag profile; no single tape-confirmed catalyst recently, just accumulating negative-leaning policy headlines around Medicare Advantage and insurer scrutiny.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Best fundamentals among the forming-support names, but the support checks (range failed, trend severe) mean the pullback hasn't been confirmed as stabilizing yet.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: RSI14 at 32.9 and a 'severe' trend failure both point to a pullback still actively sliding; sector-wide political/regulatory headline risk remains a real overhang.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Weak recent EPS record (2 misses in the last 2 quarters before a narrow beat) and a Hold-heavy analyst consensus (22 hold vs 11 buy); a J.B. Hunt diesel-cost warning on Sept 16 (now 14 days stale) weighed on the whole trucking sector.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Weakest fundamental conviction among the industrials names combined with a severe trend-check failure puts it near the bottom of the forming tier.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: HeavilyShorted, and the diesel-cost headline shows real sector-wide margin risk beyond company-specific execution; the support check confirms the slide hasn't stabilized.

sector_capped_out.research_highlight: Generally strong beat record including some very large beats against low estimates, but heavy insider selling over 90 days ($12.7M, split between a director's $6.3M sale on Sept 17 and officer sales) alongside 13.2% short interest.
sector_capped_out.rationale: Strong headline beat numbers are undercut by a large, recent director sale timed into a still-sliding stock (2 of 3 support checks failed), landing it at the bottom of the ranked list.
sector_capped_out.bear_case: A $6.3M director sale just two weeks ago, combined with heavy short interest and a support check that hasn't confirmed stabilization, is a real near-term caution flag despite the historically strong beat record.
